# ccboard

> The Dashboard Claude Code Deserves - TUI/Web dashboard for Claude Code management

## Quick Facts

- Title: ccboard
- Author: Florian Bruniaux (Founding Engineer @ Méthode Aristote)
- Version: 0.22.0
- Category: Developer Tools, CLI Dashboard, Monitoring, Analytics
- Available: Globally via GitHub, Homebrew, Cargo (crates.io)
- License: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (free, open source)
- Language: Rust
- Tests: 492
- Platforms: macOS (fully tested), Linux (community-tested), Windows (experimental)

## What ccboard Does

ccboard provides a unified dashboard for monitoring and managing Claude Code sessions. It combines 13 interactive tabs in both TUI and Web interfaces:

1. **Dashboard** - Session overview, model usage, MCP servers, 30-day activity heatmap
2. **Sessions** - All sessions with metadata, costs, live process detection + context window pressure bar
3. **Conversation Viewer** - Full JSONL replay with tool call visualization, regex search, HTML export
4. **Search** - FTS5 full-text search across all sessions with search-as-you-type
5. **Config** - Cascading configuration editor (global/project/local) with 4-column diff view
6. **Hooks** - Event-based hook management with bash syntax highlighting
7. **Agents** - Browse agents, commands, and skills with invocation stats
8. **Costs** - Budget quota gauge, MTD cost, monthly projection, billing blocks export
9. **History** - Full-text search across sessions with temporal patterns and CSV/JSON export
10. **MCP** - Server management with status detection and env vars display
11. **Analytics** - 7 sub-views: trends, patterns, summary, anomalies, costs, discover, forecasting
12. **Audit Log** - Security audit: per-session file/bash/network tool calls, cross-session violations feed
13. **Brain** - Cross-session knowledge base: hooks auto-extract progress, decisions, blockers, patterns

## Key Features

- **Live Context Window Monitoring**: Context pressure bar per active session (`[████░░░░░░] 42% ⚡`), compaction detection, incremental JSONL parsing O(delta)
- **89x Speedup**: SQLite cache with mtime invalidation (20s → 224ms)
- **Dual Interface**: TUI (Ratatui) + Web (Axum + SSE) with 100% feature parity
- **Real-time Monitoring**: File watcher with 500ms debounce + live process detection (CPU/RAM/Tokens)
- **Cost Forecasting**: 7-day, 30-day, 90-day projections with linear regression
- **Third-party Sessions**: Import sessions from Cursor, Codex CLI, and OpenCode
- **Brain Tab**: Cross-session knowledge base with auto-extract hooks and context injection
- **ccboard-ffi**: UniFFI bindings for Swift/iOS native dashboards
- **Zero Config**: Works out of the box with ~/.claude directory
- **Keybindings**: Vim-style navigation (hjkl) + Tab switching (1-9) + Search (/)

## Installation

```bash
# Homebrew
brew tap FlorianBruniaux/tap && brew install ccboard

# Cargo
cargo install ccboard

# From source
git clone https://github.com/FlorianBruniaux/ccboard
cd ccboard
cargo build --release
```

## Usage

```bash
# TUI mode (default)
ccboard

# Web interface
ccboard web --port 3333

# Both TUI + Web
ccboard both

# Search sessions
ccboard search "query" --limit 10

# Recent sessions
ccboard recent 10

# Session info
ccboard info <session-id>

# Print stats
ccboard stats
```

## Keybindings

- `Tab`/`Shift+Tab` - Navigate tabs forward/backward
- `1-9` - Jump to specific tab
- `q` - Quit
- `/` - Search within current tab
- `j/k` - Navigate lists (vim-style)
- `Enter` - Select/Open item
- `Esc` - Close dialog/popup
- `r` - Refresh data
- `b` - Toggle bookmark (Sessions tab)

## Performance

- Cache hit rate: >99%
- Initial load: ~20s (cold start, one-time)
- Cached load: 224ms (89x faster)
- Real-time updates: 500ms debounce
- Live parsing: O(delta) incremental JSONL reads
